title: 佩珀军士的孤独之心俱乐部乐队
en: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
creator: The Beatles
note: 第一张把录音室当作创作乐器的「概念专辑」，为 60 年代末的听觉野心立下标准。
noteEn: The first concept album to treat the studio as an instrument, setting the sonic ambition of the late '60s.

title: 左轮手枪
creator: The Beatles
note: 反卷带、西塔琴与磁带循环齐上阵，披头士从偶像乐队走向录音室实验室的分水岭。
noteEn: Backwards tapes, sitar and tape loops turn the Beatles from pop idols into studio scientists.

title: 艾比路
creator: The Beatles
note: 第二面那组无懈可击的组曲，是录音室精密度与旋律天赋的最后一次完美合体。
noteEn: The seamless side-two medley is the final perfect union of studio craft and melodic genius.

title: 白色专辑
creator: The Beatles
note: 三十首歌的私人拼贴，四人的个性裂痕本身就是这张专辑真正的主题。
noteEn: Thirty songs as a private collage — the four personalities drifting apart become the album's own subject.

title: 月之暗面
en: The Dark Side of the Moon
creator: Pink Floyd
note: 把摇滚做成工程级精密的概念专辑，在公告牌榜上驻留了惊人的 900 多周。
noteEn: Rock built with engineering precision — a concept album that spent over 900 weeks on the Billboard chart.

title: 愿你在此
creator: Pink Floyd
note: 献给迷失在名利场的前队友 Syd Barrett，〈Shine On You Crazy Diamond〉是摇滚最动人的悼词之一。
noteEn: An elegy for lost bandmate Syd Barrett — "Shine On You Crazy Diamond" is rock's most moving farewell.

title: 迷墙
creator: Pink Floyd
note: 把心墙筑成双专辑歌剧，疏离、战争与疯狂在每一块砖里膨胀。
noteEn: A double-album opera about alienation, war and madness, brick by brick.

title: 齐柏林飞艇四
creator: Led Zeppelin
note: 无标题专辑，却靠〈Stairway to Heaven〉成为重型摇滚的原型教科书。
noteEn: An untitled record that became heavy rock's founding text via "Stairway to Heaven."

title: 歌剧院之夜
creator: Queen
note: 〈Bohemian Rhapsody〉把歌剧、民谣与金属缝进一首六分钟单曲，是录音室挥霍的胜利。
noteEn: "Bohemian Rhapsody" sews opera, ballad and metal into one six-minute single — profligacy as triumph.

title: 流亡大街
creator: The Rolling Stones
note: 在法国流亡别墅地下室录成的双专辑，蓝调与摇滚最脏也最性感的交织。
noteEn: A double album cut in a French exile basement — the Stones at their grittiest, bluesiest best.

title: 齐格星尘的兴衰
en: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars
creator: David Bowie
note: 虚构外星摇滚巨星 Ziggy 的末日叙事，把舞台人格彻底写进摇滚史。
noteEn: The end-of-world story of fictional alien rock star Ziggy, making persona itself an art form.

title: 低迷
creator: David Bowie
note: 柏林三部曲之首，把断裂的器乐与冰冷的合成器拼在一起，预示了后朋克与氛围。
noteEn: First of the Berlin trilogy, splicing broken instrumentals with cold synths — a blueprint for post-punk and ambient.

title: 下一个是谁
creator: The Who
note: 〈Baba O'Riley〉的合成器律动与〈Behind Blue Eyes〉的脆弱，撑起硬摇滚的抒情边界。
noteEn: The synth pulse of "Baba O'Riley" and the fragility of "Behind Blue Eyes" stretch hard rock's emotional range.

title: 别在意
creator: Nirvana
note: 把另类摇滚砸进主流视野的爆炸性专辑，〈Smells Like Teen Spirit〉改写了一代人的音量。
noteEn: The record that detonated alternative rock into the mainstream, rewiring a generation's volume.

title: OK 电脑
creator: Radiohead
note: 用吉他、电子脉冲与不安的歌词预演了千禧年的疏离，屡被票选为九十年代最佳专辑。
noteEn: Guitar, electronic pulses and paranoid lyrics foretold millennial alienation — repeatedly crowned the '90s' best album.

title: 一号复制人
creator: Radiohead
note: 抛弃吉他摇滚，用鼓机、采样与扭曲人声重建一个冰河纪的听觉景观。
noteEn: Ditching guitars for drum machines, samples and mangled vocals, Radiohead rebuilt a glacial landscape.

title: 彩虹里
creator: Radiohead
note: 「随你付」定价开启数字发行的新范式，音乐本身却是他们最温暖的一张。
noteEn: A pay-what-you-want release that rewrote digital economics — and the band's warmest record.

title: 约书亚之树
creator: U2
note: 在美国沙漠里拍出的大片感摇滚，让 U2 从都柏林乐队变成世界级命题。
noteEn: Cinematic rock shot in the American desert, turning U2 from Dublin band into global statement.

title: 你经历过了吗
creator: The Jimi Hendrix Experience
note: 首张专辑就把电吉他的语言改写：反馈、哇音与那首〈Purple Haze〉。
noteEn: A debut that rewrote the electric guitar's grammar — feedback, wah and "Purple Haze."

title: 地下丝绒与妮可
creator: The Velvet Underground
note: 当年几乎卖不动，却启发了无数乐队——关于药、性与噪音的坦白被时间正名。
noteEn: Sold next to nothing yet inspired countless bands — time vindicated this unflinching, noisy debut.

title: 未知的欢愉
creator: Joy Division
note: 那张脉冲星封面与 Ian Curtis 的深渊低吟，共同定义了后朋克的冷。
noteEn: A pulsar cover and Ian Curtis's abyssal baritone defined the cold of post-punk.

title: 伦敦呼叫
creator: The Clash
note: 朋克没有限制他们的愤怒，反而让他们写进雷鬼、放克与摇滚混合的双专辑。
noteEn: Punk didn't limit their rage — it let them splice reggae, funk and rock into a double album.

title: 生为奔跑
creator: Bruce Springsteen
note: 「今晚我们奔向胜利」的逃逸宣言，把新泽西的蓝领渴望谱成摇滚国歌。
noteEn: An anthem of escape and working-class longing, turning New Jersey into rock's promised land.

title: 为人民自动
creator: R.E.M.
note: 近乎民谣的安静内省之作，〈Nightswimming〉把乡愁拍成黑白胶片。
noteEn: Quiet, near-folk introspection — "Nightswimming" develops nostalgia like a roll of black-and-white film.

title: 谣言
creator: Fleetwood Mac
note: 乐队成员集体分手的产物，把私密伤痛做成软摇滚最精致的流行机器。
noteEn: Forged from the band's collective breakups, it polished private pain into the sleekest pop-rock machine of the '70s.

title: 女王已死
creator: The Smiths
note: Morrissey 的机智刻薄配上 Marr 的吉他清亮，把独立流行写成反主流宣言。
noteEn: Morrissey's wit and Marr's gleaming guitar turn indie pop into a counter-mainstream manifesto.

title: 回到黑暗
creator: AC/DC
note: 在故主 Bon Scott 离世后以新主唱重生，成为史上最畅销的摇滚专辑之一。
noteEn: Reborn with a new singer after Bon Scott's death — one of the best-selling rock albums ever.

title: 傀儡之主
creator: Metallica
note: 把鞭击金属的复杂编曲推到巅峰，2016 年入选美国国家录音典藏。
noteEn: Thrash metal's compositional peak, added to the National Recording Registry in 2016.

title: 白日梦国度
creator: Sonic Youth
note: 另类摇滚把调音当作创作手段的长篇宣言，影响整个九十年代的独立场景。
noteEn: A sprawling alt-rock manifesto treating alternate tunings as composition — the blueprint for '90s indie.

title: 留在光明中
creator: Talking Heads
note: 把非洲放克律动塞进后朋克骨架，循环采样让乐队听起来像一支不断增殖的方阵。
noteEn: African funk polyrhythms in a post-punk chassis — looping samples make the band feel like a multiplying ensemble.

title: 郊区
creator: Arcade Fire
note: 把郊区的怀旧与焦虑写成乐队摇滚的宏大叙事，2011 年同时拿下水星奖与格莱美。
noteEn: Nostalgia and anxiety about suburbia as grand indie rock — Mercury Prize and Grammy winner in 2011.

title: 晨光荣耀
creator: Oasis
note: 英伦流行最大声的宣言，〈Wonderwall〉与〈Don't Look Back in Anger〉成为一代国歌。
noteEn: Britpop's loudest statement — "Wonderwall" and "Don't Look Back in Anger" became generational anthems.

title: 奥德赛与神谕
creator: The Zombies
note: 巴洛克流行遗珠，发行即被忽视，多年后〈Time of the Season〉让它成为经典。
noteEn: A baroque-pop gem ignored at release, resurrected when "Time of the Season" finally charted.

title: 杜立德
creator: Pixies
note: 动静切换的「软-硬」范式，直接催生了 Nirvana 的 Nevermind。
noteEn: The loud-quiet-loud template that directly fathered Nirvana's Nevermind.

title: 颤栗
creator: Michael Jackson
note: 史上最畅销专辑之一，七首 Top 10 单曲，把音乐录影带变成一门产业。
noteEn: One of the best-selling albums ever, with seven Top-10 singles — it turned the music video into an industry.

title: 飙
creator: Michael Jackson
note: 紧接 Thriller 的连冠专辑，〈Smooth Criminal〉把舞蹈编排推向电影级。
noteEn: The chart-topping follow-up to Thriller — "Smooth Criminal" pushed choreography to cinematic scale.

title: 墙外
creator: Michael Jackson
note: 与 Quincy Jones 的首次合作，把迪斯科、放克与灵魂乐熔成成人流行的模板。
noteEn: First collaboration with Quincy Jones, fusing disco, funk and soul into the template for adult pop.

title: 宛如祈祷者
creator: Madonna
note: 麦当娜最私人也最大胆的一张，MV 里的宗教意象让全世界哗然。
noteEn: Madonna's most personal and provocative record — its religious imagery ignited global controversy.

title: 光芒万丈
creator: Madonna
note: 与 William Orbit 合作的电子流行转向，也是麦当娜的灵性转折点。
noteEn: A William Orbit-produced turn into electronic pop — and Madonna's spiritual reinvention.

title: 紫雨
creator: Prince and the Revolution
note: 同名电影与专辑互为注脚，〈Purple Rain〉让 Prince 成为当时代的天王，并拿下奥斯卡原创歌曲配乐奖。
noteEn: Album and film in dialogue — "Purple Rain" made Prince the reigning star of the era and won an Academy Award for its score.

title: 时代印记
creator: Prince
note: 双碟横跨放克、民谣、摇滚与电子，是 Prince 一生创造力最湍急的河流。
noteEn: A double album spanning funk, balladry, rock and electronics — Prince's most torrential creative peak.

title: 抵达
creator: ABBA
note: 〈Dancing Queen〉就在这张里，把瑞典的旋律工业推向全球。
noteEn: Home of "Dancing Queen" — the record that made Sweden's melody machine global.

title: 惠特妮·休斯顿
creator: Whitney Houston
note: 史上最畅销的女歌手处子专辑之一，〈Saving All My Love for You〉为她捧回第一座格莱美。
noteEn: One of the best-selling female debuts ever; "Saving All My Love for You" won her first Grammy.

title: 坠入爱河
creator: Celine Dion
note: 全球超三千万销量的抒情巨轮，为成人抒情在格莱美正名。
noteEn: A 30-million-selling ballad juggernaut that gave adult contemporary its Grammy vindication.

creator: Adele
note: 分手专辑卖出三千万张，〈Rolling in the Deep〉把灵魂乐推向全球广播。
noteEn: A breakup album that sold 30 million — "Rolling in the Deep" carried soul onto global radio.

creator: Adele
note: 〈Hello〉一出手就打破首周销量纪录，用最朴素的写法收割最广的听众。
noteEn: "Hello" smashed first-week sales records — the plainest songwriting reaching the widest audience.

title: 柠檬水
creator: Beyoncé
note: 一张视觉专辑，把背叛、黑人与女性经验拍成六十分钟的檄文。
noteEn: A visual album — sixty minutes on betrayal, Blackness and womanhood, delivered as a manifesto.

creator: Taylor Swift
note: 从乡村转向全合成器流行，〈Shake It Off〉让她成为奖项收割机。
noteEn: A full synth-pop pivot from country — "Shake It Off" turned her into an awards machine.

title: 民俗志
creator: Taylor Swift
note: 隔离期的民谣转向，与 The National 的合作让她的写作沉到室内乐般的密度。
noteEn: A lockdown indie-folk turn with The National, sinking her songwriting to chamber-music density.

title: 名声
creator: Lady Gaga
note: 〈Poker Face〉与〈Just Dance〉把舞池流行和艺术人格一起推向主流。
noteEn: "Poker Face" and "Just Dance" took dance-pop and an art-school persona straight to the mainstream.

title: 未来乡愁
creator: Dua Lipa
note: 把迪斯科回潮做成疫情时代的逃生舱，〈Levitating〉是全世界的舞池。
noteEn: Disco revival as pandemic escape pod — "Levitating" became the world's dance floor.

title: 当我们睡着时，我们去往何处
en: When We All Fall Asleep, Where Do We Go?
creator: Billie Eilish
note: 卧室录音的耳语美学横扫格莱美四大通类，成为 Z 世代的时代音。
noteEn: Bedroom-recorded whisper-pop swept the four general Grammy categories — the sound of a generation.

title: 纯真挽歌
creator: Lorde
note: 把青春期的心碎与派对做成概念化的室内乐流行，水星奖遗珠。
noteEn: Teenage heartbreak and house parties as a chamber-pop concept record — a Mercury shortlist gem.

title: 哈里的房子
creator: Harry Styles
note: 以七十年代软摇滚为底的流行私房照，2023 年拿下格莱美年度专辑。
noteEn: A '70s-soft-rock-tinged pop house tour that won Album of the Year at the 2023 Grammys.

title: 酸
creator: Olivia Rodrigo
note: 把少女的心碎写得句句扎心，〈drivers license〉创下流媒体时代的纪录。
noteEn: Teen heartbreak written with brutal precision — "drivers license" set streaming-era records.

title: 信念
creator: George Michael
note: 单飞后的全能宣言，包办词曲制作，〈Faith〉拿下 1988 年格莱美年度专辑。
noteEn: A one-man solo statement — written, produced and performed by George Michael, Grammy Album of the Year 1988.

title: 节奏国度 1814
creator: Janet Jackson
note: 用放克节拍讲社会议题，概念与舞蹈编排都走在时代前头。
noteEn: Funk beats carrying social commentary — a concept and choreography years ahead of its time.

title: 爱的猎犬
creator: Kate Bush
note: 〈Running Up That Hill〉把电子流行带进高概念叙事，第二面是完整的艺术歌剧。
noteEn: "Running Up That Hill" fuses electronic pop with high concept; side two is a complete art-opera.

title: 反了
creator: Rihanna
note: 比流行更松、比 R&B 更怪，〈Work〉之外塞满险象环生的冒险。
noteEn: Looser than pop, stranger than R&B — beyond "Work," a record full of adventurous detours.

title: 她如此不寻常
creator: Cyndi Lauper
note: 彩虹发色与〈Time After Time〉，把新浪潮气质做成畅销排行榜的主流。
noteEn: Rainbow hair and "Time After Time" — new-wave quirk turned into chart-topping mainstream.

title: 欧洲特快列车
creator: Kraftwerk
note: 用节拍器般的电子脉冲模拟列车之旅，彻底改写了流行乐对「机械」的想象。
noteEn: Simulating a train journey with metronomic pulses, it rewired pop's imagination of the machine.

title: 人机
creator: Kraftwerk
note: 机器人穿西装唱歌的封面，是「人机合一」美学最直接的宣言。
noteEn: Robots in suits on the cover — the most literal statement of the man-machine aesthetic.

title: 发现
creator: Daft Punk
note: 用采样把七十年代迪斯科变成未来主义流行，〈One More Time〉是全球舞池的共同记忆。
noteEn: Sampling '70s disco into futuristic pop — "One More Time" is dance music's shared memory.

title: 随机存取记忆
creator: Daft Punk
note: 请来真人乐手重新演奏迪斯科，〈Get Lucky〉让 Daft Punk 拿下格莱美年度专辑。
noteEn: Live musicians re-playing disco — "Get Lucky" carried Daft Punk to a Grammy Album of the Year.

title: 作业
creator: Daft Punk
note: 把粗粝的芝加哥浩室与放克采样打包，定义了法国电子入侵的起点。
noteEn: Raw Chicago house and funk samples packed into a debut that launched the French electronic invasion.

title: 自掘坟墓
creator: The Chemical Brothers
note: Big Beat 在商业与创意上的双料巅峰，〈Block Rockin' Beats〉是仓库派对的战鼓。
noteEn: Big-beat's commercial and creative peak — "Block Rockin' Beats" as the warehouse war drum.

title: 精选环境作品 85-92
creator: Aphex Twin
note: 用极简合成器音色把氛围与节拍缝在一起，让卧室制作成为一门艺术。
noteEn: Stitching ambient and beat-driven electronics from minimal synth tones, it made bedroom production an art.

title: 理查德·D·詹姆斯专辑
creator: Aphex Twin
note: 复杂到近乎痉挛的节拍，把电子音乐的「精确疯狂」推到极限。
noteEn: Breakbeats complex to the point of spasm — electronic precision taken to the edge of madness.

title: 同质
creator: Björk
note: 弦乐与节拍撞击出冰岛式的冷艳，〈Jóga〉是她最锋利的一张名片。
noteEn: Strings colliding with beats in Icelandic cold beauty — "Jóga" is her sharpest calling card.

title: 昼伏夜出
creator: Björk
note: 把竖琴、冰晶般的音色与耳语人声做成冬日情书，私密到令人屏息。
noteEn: Harps, crystalline textures and whispered vocals as a winter love letter — intimate enough to hold your breath.

title: 蓝线
creator: Massive Attack
note: 被追认为「Trip-Hop」的起点，把缓拍、爵士采样与说唱揉成一团烟雾。
noteEn: Retroactively the birthplace of trip-hop — slow beats, jazz samples and rap dissolved into smoke.

title: 夹层
creator: Massive Attack
note: 〈Teardrop〉的冰冷吟唱配上吉他失真，让 Trip-Hop 走向暗黑与宏大。
noteEn: The cold vocal of "Teardrop" over distorted guitar — trip-hop grown dark and monumental.

title: 假人
creator: Portishead
note: 1995 年水星奖得主，把电影配乐的幽暗与嘻哈采样接到 Beth Gibbons 的鬼魅人声。
noteEn: Winner of the 1995 Mercury Prize — film-score gloom and hip-hop samples under Beth Gibbons's ghostly voice.

title: 土地的肥脂
creator: The Prodigy
note: 〈Smack My Bitch Up〉与〈Firestarter〉把电子乐的狂暴带进主流体育场。
noteEn: "Smack My Bitch Up" and "Firestarter" carried electronic rage into the mainstream arena.

title: 月球旅行
creator: Air
note: 法式闲适电子的代表作，〈Sexy Boy〉让「轻松」成为九十年代末的奢侈。
noteEn: The sound of French nonchalance — "Sexy Boy" made effortlessness the luxury of the late '90s.

title: 侵犯者
creator: Depeche Mode
note: 〈Personal Jesus〉与〈Enjoy the Silence〉，把合成器流行推到教堂般庄严的高度。
noteEn: "Personal Jesus" and "Enjoy the Silence" lift synth-pop to cathedral solemnity.

title: 不真实
creator: Burial
note: 把车库人声采样、雨声与地下铁音效做成一张失恋后的南伦敦夜地图。
noteEn: Sampled garage vocals, rain and tube-station ambience — a night map of south London after heartbreak.

title: 音乐有权属于孩子
en: Music Has the Right to Children
creator: Boards of Canada
note: 用老旧合成器与教育影片采样制造「童年记忆的失真」，IDM 的乡愁鼻祖。
noteEn: Old synths and educational-film samples as corrupted childhood memory — IDM's nostalgic origin.

title: 机场音乐
creator: Brian Eno
note: Eno 定义「氛围音乐」的开山之作，为机场候机厅设计出可忽略又动人的背景。
noteEn: The founding text of ambient — music designed to be ignorable yet affecting, first for an airport lobby.

title: 氧气
creator: Jean-Michel Jarre
note: 全模拟合成器做成的法国电子原声带，全球销量超 1500 万张。
noteEn: French electronic score built entirely on analogue synths — over 15 million copies sold worldwide.

title: 低音在我的脑海中
creator: Underworld
note: 把浩室、科技舞曲与即兴人声黏合成夜店圣歌，为英国锐舞时代立传。
noteEn: House, techno and improvised vocals fused into rave anthems — the soundtrack to UK rave culture.

title: 轮舞
creator: Four Tet
note: 把爵士、民谣与电子采样织成一张会呼吸的有机挂毯，现场感独一无二。
noteEn: Jazz, folk and electronic samples woven into a breathing, organic tapestry — a one-of-a-kind texture.

title: 图解
creator: Nas
note: 二十岁 Nas 的处子作，十首歌十位金牌制作人，说唱写作的完美范本。
noteEn: A twenty-year-old's debut — ten tracks, ten A-list producers, hip-hop lyricism at its purest.

title: 武当派入门（三十六房）
creator: Wu-Tang Clan
note: 把武侠片采样、粗糙节拍与九人团体变成东海岸的一支民兵队。
noteEn: Martial-arts samples, raw beats and a nine-man crew as an East Coast militia.

title: 准备好赴死
creator: The Notorious B.I.G.
note: Biggie 用厚实的叙事流把街头苦难讲成电影，东海岸复兴的核心文献。
noteEn: Biggie's dense narrative flow turns street struggle into cinema — the core text of East Coast revival.

title: 众目睽睽
creator: 2Pac
note: 嘻哈史上第一张双碟全长专辑，把西海岸黑帮说唱写成宏大的自传。
noteEn: Hip-hop's first full-length double album, turning West Coast gangsta rap into a sprawling autobiography.

title: 慢性
creator: Dr. Dre
note: G-funk 的奠基之作，慢速放克采样让西海岸说唱找到了标志性的「慵懒」。
noteEn: The founding document of G-funk — slowed funk samples gave West Coast rap its signature lope.

creator: Dr. Dre
note: 启用 Eminem 与 Snoop 的跨世纪制作大秀，〈Still D.R.E.〉是西海岸的加冕礼。
noteEn: A millennial production showcase launching Eminem — "Still D.R.E." as West Coast coronation.

title: 狗样
creator: Snoop Dogg
note: Snoop 松弛的唱腔配上 G-funk，让说唱听起来像一种毫不费力的生活方式。
noteEn: Snoop's laid-back drawl over G-funk made rap sound like an effortless lifestyle.

title: 水瓶与双子
creator: OutKast
note: 南方的怪诞灵魂乐与说唱在亚特兰大相遇，〈Rosa Parks〉让它进入流行视野。
noteEn: Southern weirdness, soul and rap meeting in Atlanta — "Rosa Parks" pushed it into the mainstream.

title: 扬声器与爱之深
creator: OutKast
note: 两张个人唱片合成一张双碟，〈Hey Ya!〉让它拿到 2004 年格莱美年度专辑。
noteEn: Two solo records in one double album — "Hey Ya!" carried it to the 2004 Grammy Album of the Year.

title: 辍学
creator: Kanye West
note: 把灵魂乐采样切成高级时装般的节拍，Kanye 把说唱带进学院与教堂之间。
noteEn: Soul samples cut like couture — Kanye placed rap between the academy and the church.

title: 迟到注册
creator: Kanye West
note: 与 Jon Brion 联手引入弦乐编排，〈Gold Digger〉把他推向全球舞台。
noteEn: Jon Brion's string arrangements and "Gold Digger" — Kanye's orchestral pop-rap breakthrough.

title: 我美丽黑暗扭曲的幻想
creator: Kanye West
note: 众星云集的巴洛克说唱史诗，把自负与脆弱同时放大到专辑规模。
noteEn: A baroque, all-star rap epic that amplifies ego and fragility to album scale.

title: 好孩子，疯狂的城
creator: Kendrick Lamar
note: 概念化的康普顿成长日记，把街头叙事拍成一部可以反复重看的电影。
noteEn: A conceptual Compton coming-of-age diary, shot like a film you can rewatch endlessly.

title: 给蝴蝶拉皮条
creator: Kendrick Lamar
note: 放克、爵士与自由爵士的现场乐队质感，把黑人性、阶级与自我怀疑写成一部长诗。
noteEn: Live funk, jazz and free-jazz textures turning Blackness, class and self-doubt into a long-form poem.

title: 该死
creator: Kendrick Lamar
note: 更紧凑也更流行的转向，2018 年成为首个获得普利策音乐奖的说唱专辑。
noteEn: A tighter, more pop-facing turn — the first rap album to win the Pulitzer Prize for Music.

title: 马歇尔·马瑟斯专辑
creator: Eminem
note: 把自传式的愤怒与恶趣味做成世纪之交最畅销的说唱专辑之一。
noteEn: Autobiographical rage and bad taste — one of the best-selling rap albums of the era.

title: 蓝图
creator: Jay-Z
note: 在 9·11 当周发行，Kanye 制作的灵魂采样节拍让 Jay-Z 找到中年后的自信。
noteEn: Released the week of 9/11, Kanye's soul-sampled beats gave Jay-Z a new, assured maturity.

title: 合理怀疑
creator: Jay-Z
note: 处子作就是巅峰级黑帮叙事，冷静的弦乐采样定义了纽约九十年代的雅痞说唱。
noteEn: A debut at peak gangsta-narrative form — cool string samples defined '90s New York rap refinement.

title: 劳伦·希尔的教育
creator: Lauryn Hill
note: 首位凭说唱专辑拿下格莱美年度专辑的女性，灵魂、雷鬼与嘻哈一体。
noteEn: The first woman to win Album of the Year for a rap album — soul, reggae and hip-hop as one.

title: 低音端理论
creator: A Tribe Called Quest
note: 把爵士贝斯与清醒的韵律接在一起，奠定了「另类说唱」的语法。
noteEn: Jazz bass and a lucid flow — the record that codified alternative rap's grammar.

title: 疯狂恶棍
creator: Madvillain (MF DOOM & Madlib)
note: 两位地下怪杰的合体，把采样拼贴与意识流押韵做成抽象说唱的圣杯。
noteEn: Two underground eccentrics colliding — sample collage and stream-of-consciousness rhyme as abstract rap's grail.

title: 掀起地狱
creator: Run-D.M.C.
note: 与 Aerosmith 合作〈Walk This Way〉，把说唱与摇滚一起推上主流电台。
noteEn: Teaming with Aerosmith on "Walk This Way" carried rap and rock to mainstream radio together.

title: 乐谱
creator: The Fugees
note: 〈Killing Me Softly〉让嘻哈灵魂翻唱火遍全球，Lauryn Hill 一鸣惊人。
noteEn: "Killing Me Softly" took hip-hop soul worldwide and made Lauryn Hill a star overnight.

title: 怎么了
creator: Marvin Gaye
note: 第一张把越战、环保与都市绝望唱进灵魂乐的概念专辑，黑人的时代省思。
noteEn: The first soul concept album addressing Vietnam, ecology and urban despair — Black America's reckoning.

title: 生命之钥
en: Songs in the Key of Life
creator: Stevie Wonder
note: 双碟的流行灵魂百科全书，1977 年格莱美年度专辑。
noteEn: A double-album encyclopedia of pop-soul, Grammy Album of the Year 1977.

title: 内在视觉
creator: Stevie Wonder
note: 合成器与政治自觉同时成熟的杰作，〈Living for the City〉是他的叙事巅峰。
noteEn: Synths and political consciousness maturing together — "Living for the City" at his narrative peak.

title: 会说话的书
creator: Stevie Wonder
note: 〈Superstition〉的 Clavinet 律动成为放克灵魂的教科书段落。
noteEn: "Superstition"'s clavinet riff became a textbook passage in funk-soul rhythm.

title: 我从未如此爱过一个男人
en: I Never Loved a Man the Way I Love You
creator: Aretha Franklin
note: Aretha 在 Atlantic 的首张专辑，〈Respect〉从此成为权利与尊严的国歌。
noteEn: Aretha's Atlantic debut — "Respect" became an anthem of rights and dignity forever.

title: 奇异恩典
creator: Aretha Franklin
note: 在洛杉矶教堂实况录制的福音现场，被公认为史上最伟大的福音专辑之一。
noteEn: A live gospel recording in an LA church — widely ranked among the greatest live gospel albums ever.

title: 乡村与西部音乐的新声音
en: Modern Sounds in Country and Western Music
creator: Ray Charles
note: 把乡村金曲改造成灵魂乐编曲，跨类型的胆识震惊了整个行业。
noteEn: Country standards reimagined as soul arrangements — a genre-bending move that stunned the industry.

title: 奥蒂斯蓝调
creator: Otis Redding
note: 一天之内录完的灵魂巅峰，把翻唱与原创一起烧成南部热浪。
noteEn: A soul peak recorded in a single day, originals and covers scorching with Southern heat.

title: 阿波罗现场
creator: James Brown
note: 一张现场专辑让灵魂乐第一次拥有「史诗现场」的概念，能量几乎掀翻屋顶。
noteEn: A live album that invented the idea of the epic soul concert — energy threatening to lift the roof.

title: 暴乱进行时
creator: Sly and the Family Stone
note: 用失真的鼓机与低沉的 funk 讲出理想幻灭，比同时代的任何专辑都更阴郁。
noteEn: Distorted drums and low-slung funk about disillusionment — gloomier than almost anything of its time.

title: 巫毒
creator: D'Angelo
note: 现场乐队录制的「新灵魂乐」杰作，〈Untitled (How Does It Feel)〉让 MTV 一度瘫痪。
noteEn: A neo-soul masterpiece cut live in the studio — "Untitled (How Does It Feel)" froze MTV.

title: 巴杜主义
creator: Erykah Badu
note: 头巾与唱腔把「另类 R&B」带上主流，1998 年拿下最佳 R&B 专辑。
noteEn: Head-wraps and phrasing brought "alternative R&B" mainstream — Grammy Best R&B Album 1998.

title: 回到黑色
creator: Amy Winehouse
note: 六十年代女子组合式的复古灵魂，2008 年格莱美年度专辑。
noteEn: '60s girl-group soul rebuilt in the modern day — Grammy Album of the Year 2008.

title: 橙色频道
creator: Frank Ocean
note: 把自传式的诚实放进 R&B 的柔光里，〈Thinkin Bout You〉让酷儿叙事进入主流。
noteEn: Autobiographical honesty in R&B's soft focus — "Thinkin Bout You" brought queer narratives mainstream.

title: 金发
creator: Frank Ocean
note: 极简的编曲与人声采样，把私人记忆做成一张可以被反复解读的概念专辑。
noteEn: Minimal arrangements and vocal samples turning private memory into endlessly interpretable concept art.
